validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE/CLASSIFICATION: confirmed. Independent 2023 Russian press (dela.ru procurement-lot article naming KS Volodino explicitly + TASS quoting Deputy PM Novak) describes a real, government-tracked ~700 km gas trunk project from KS Volodino (Tomsk Oblast) to Krasnoyarsk, targeted for first gas by 2028, part of the federally-tracked «Восточная система газоснабжения» (816-р federal planning schema, item 364, which places Сельское поселение Володинское on the route). Correctly a transmission-scale trunk, not a gathering/distribution line. Not a duplicate of another roster row: P2376 (Proskokovo–Achinsk–Krasnoyarsk–Kansk–Balagansk, cancelled, len=1600) was an OLDER, DIFFERENT routing (starts Proskokovo, not Volodino) for the same goal (gasify Krasnoyarsk); P6535 (Volodino start) reads as the routing that superseded it, not the same physical pipe. dela.ru/news/284000 also states the completed line will later become part of «Сила Сибири – 2» (Power of Siberia 2) and that the archaeological-survey lot specifically covers a KS‑15–KS‑16-to-km-3064 sub-section of a longer «KS Volodino – Irkutsk» corridor — i.e. Krasnoyarsk (this row's endpoint) is described as an intermediate/first-stage target on a route that continues to Irkutsk; worth noting for whoever researches PoS-2 (not in this batch's roster) or any future Volodino–Irkutsk row, but not grounds to merge/reclassify P6535 itself. Two concerns filed separately: Owner=Sonatrach (attribution) and Capacity=28.50 sourced only to a system-wide figure (spec).
